free_tier_limits: Basic (free) includes all signals and endpoints for CAISO_NORTH, plus the CO2 percentile signal for all covered regions.
rate_limits: 3,000 requests per rolling 5-minute window per user (10 requests/second average); /login is limited to 100 requests per 5 minutes.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Corrected per https://watttime.org/docs-dev/data-plans/. rate_limits: Corrected; OpenAPI specifies 3,000 requests per rolling 5 minutes per user and 100 per 5 minutes for /login: https://docs.watttime.org/openapi.json. example: Corrected; OpenAPI documents GET /v3/signal-index and requires region plus signal_type=co2_moer; the original omitted signal_type: https://docs.watttime.org/openapi.json.
